note: PASS means insecure observation reproduced. No user vault, real USB, or OS settings accessed.

results.name: A01 exported package decrypts without password, secret key, or USB
results.details: Real export/import service; no USB API or credential supplied to import.

results.name: A02 local data decrypts from stored metadata without user input
results.details: Fresh service invocation needs only the saved plan and ciphertext, no password input.

results.name: A03 encryption failure writes plaintext fallback
results.details: Injected CSPRNG failure; plaintext persisted in legacylock_items.

results.name: A04 absent takeover factors accepted
results.details: Both factors disabled: any nonempty UI password can pass service verification.

results.name: A05 fabricated container passes all six health checks
results.details: Invalid signature, ciphertext, and key data reported Healthy / 100; rescue assumed present.

results.name: A06 browser dual USB fallback reports success without decryption
results.details: Same path used for both drives; no key bytes read.

results.name: A07 lock-screen USB action calls unlock without cryptographic verification
results.details: Actual click handler has no master key read, CLI unlock, password, or ciphertext verification.

results.name: A08 read-only import persists data but restart defaults to owner
results.details: Actual import handler + real storage, with source-verified nonpersistent role initializers; not a desktop restart test.

results.name: A09 failed native backup response still reports success
results.details: Actual UI handler consumes resolved success:false as success.

results.name: A10 migration reports success with only timers and no file operations
results.details: Actual handler runs in a context with no filesystem or IPC APIs.

results.name: A11 normal import discards original plan and read-only result
results.details: Actual handler forwards items and overwrite only; original authentication configuration is dropped.

results.name: A12 deleting binding file bypasses anti-clone check
results.details: Real IPC handler, in-memory filesystem reports binding file absent.

results.name: A13 privileged IPC accepts untrusted sender and caller-selected path
results.details: Direct IPC unit invocation, stubbed filesystem; demonstrates absent guards, not a demonstrated remote exploit.

results.name: A14 plaintext import needs no authentication and returns writable
results.details: JSON compatibility channel is accepted without password/secret; UI labels it double verification.
